_comment: What json-error-answer.js says for an error no route answered, keyed by the error's type as body-parser and raw-body name it (err.type). A type listed here is the client's fault and keeps the status the parser gave it; any other error is answered as unknownErrorAnswer with status 500. Every answer is JSON, by name, with an errorId, and never carries the error's own message, stack or a path (todo 794a45ec). The detail goes to the server log under the same errorId.

entity.too.large.reason: the request body is larger than this route accepts

entity.parse.failed.reason: the request body could not be read as the content type it declares

entity.verify.failed.reason: the request body failed this route's check

encoding.unsupported.reason: the request body's content encoding is not one this server reads

charset.unsupported.reason: the request body's character set is not one this server reads

request.aborted.reason: the request ended before its body arrived

request.size.invalid.reason: the request body's length does not match its Content-Length

parameters.too.many.reason: the request body has more parameters than this server reads

unknownErrorAnswer.reason: the server could not answer this request
